name: VARIOLINUM
key_symptoms: Morbid fear of small-pox. Deafness. Pain in occiput. Inflamed eyelids.
Oppressed breathing. Throat feels closed. Cough with thick viscid, bloody mucus. Feeling of a lump in right side of throat.
